user.title: Connect PiPower 5
user.description: Battery protection is always enabled while this integration is loaded. At the effective threshold, two consecutive readings trigger graceful HAOS host shutdown. A higher board firmware threshold takes precedence. No firmware settings are changed.

error.invalid_thresholds: Warning must be above shutdown; shutdown must be 15–90%.
